detail.body:
## Description

Add `actor.losses` for composing token objectives with independent support masks, reductions, and coefficients. Built-in policy, entropy, and MOPD objectives share an explicit callable contract with custom plugins.

An empty mapping preserves the existing actor objective. Each named term inherits `actor.loss_aggregation` unless it specifies its own reduction. The new `turn_mean` reduction averages supported-token means over active turns; existing token, sequence, prompt, and constant reductions remain available.

The implementation reuses the existing optimizer-step reduction contract and response-level schedule. Prompt groups can span optimizer steps, each term retains its original normalization support, and empty terms contribute differentiable zeros. MOPD continues to use immutable behavior log-probabilities. English and Chinese documentation cover configuration precedence, mask alignment, extension contracts, and compatibility limits.

## Related Issue

Depends on #1784 and uses the named-loss engine contract introduced by #1782. This PR targets the advantage-pipeline branch from #1784 so its diff contains only the loss changes; it will be retargeted to `main` after #1784 merges. No dedicated issue is associated with this change.

## Type of Change

- [x] ✨ New feature

## Validation

- CPU regression: 628 tests passed across actor losses, PPO/SAPO/CISPO, advantage computation, MOPD, normalization, and named engine contracts.
- Plugin contract tests: 52 CPU cases passed; CUDA cases are validated separately.
- GPU regression on the submitted revision: 663 tests passed, including 10 named reduction oracle cases, 13 advantage cases, and multiprocess normalization tests.
- Two-node dense (Qwen3-0.6B) and MoE (Qwen3-30B-A3B) training: the default objective path matches the base branch exactly in outputs, gradients, and parameters. Mixed named-loss training completed three updates and matched its deterministic repeat exactly. These comparisons preceded the final diagnostic dtype fix; objective computation is unchanged.
- Real GRPO end-to-end training on the submitted revision passed: two successful updates, 64 rollouts including updated-weight samples, weight-version publication, and finite changed checkpoints.
- Two-node context-parallel training on the submitted revision (DP2/TP2/CP2) completed three updates each for the base-branch objective, the unchanged default objective, the composed objective, and a repeat of the composed objective. The default objective matched the base branch exactly; the composed objective matched its repeat exactly in this run. It used default FusedAttention selection; the first attempt with strict deterministic attention stopped before the loss callback due to an existing Transformer Engine/FlashAttention interface incompatibility.
- Full `pre-commit run --all-files` and canonical `./docs/build_all.sh` passed.

Focused contract command:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/test_actor_loss_plugins.py tests/test_actor_loss_distributed.py tests/test_named_loss_contract.py tests/test_named_loss_engines.py -q
```

Training integration uses Megatron and SGLang. FSDP/Archon end-to-end training, MTP, long-run convergence, and performance benchmarking are not included. Engine and scheduler implementations are unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [x] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [x] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

## Additional Context

The main review areas are per-term denominator isolation, prompt normalization across optimizer steps, prediction-aligned masks, and MOPD configuration precedence. Named coefficients replace implicit objective composition; MOPD settings still determine target and advantage preparation.

Explicit named objectives do not support legacy single-teacher `teacher_logp` or forward-dependent M2PO selection. Their existing unnamed paths remain available. Efficiency presets and separate process-reward routing are outside this PR.

+
+"""Temporal estimators and local process shaping for PPO advantages."""
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from areal.trainer.ppo.gae import (
+    _compute_token_level_gae,
+    _compute_turn_level_gae,
+    compute_gae_lambda,
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TemporalInputs:
+    """Next-token-aligned reward channels and explicit trajectory bootstraps.
+
+    ``rewards`` contains only outcome rewards. ``process_rewards`` contains
+    process rewards folded onto turn ends, while ``kl_rewards`` contains token
+    KL penalties. Keeping channels separate preserves the established addition
+    order and prevents turn GAE from including KL in critic targets.
+
+    Callable lambda functions receive lengths in the estimator's timestep unit.
+    """
+
+    rewards: torch.Tensor
+    values: torch.Tensor
+    loss_mask: torch.Tensor
+    seq_no_eos_mask: torch.Tensor
+    bootstrap_values: torch.Tensor
+    discount: float
+    gae_lambda: float | torch.Tensor | Callable
+    gae_lambda_kwargs: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+    turn_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    kl_rewards: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    process_rewards: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TemporalResult:
+    advantages: torch.Tensor
+    returns: torch.Tensor
+    total_rewards: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def token_gae(inputs: TemporalInputs) -> TemporalResult:
+    """Estimate token GAE, including KL in both actor and critic targets."""
+    rewards = inputs.rewards
+    if inputs.kl_rewards is not None:
+        rewards = inputs.kl_rewards + rewards
+    if inputs.process_rewards is not None:
+        rewards = rewards + inputs.process_rewards
+    advantages, returns = _compute_token_level_gae(
+        rewards=rewards,
+        values=inputs.values,
+        loss_mask=inputs.loss_mask,
+        seq_no_eos_mask=inputs.seq_no_eos_mask,
+        bootstrap_values=inputs.bootstrap_values,
+        discount=inputs.discount,
+        gae_lambda=compute_gae_lambda(
+            inputs.gae_lambda,
+            inputs.loss_mask,
+            inputs.turn_ids,
+            timestep_unit="token",
+            kwargs=inputs.gae_lambda_kwargs,
+        ),
+    )
+    return TemporalResult(advantages=advantages, returns=returns, total_rewards=rewards)
+
+
+def turn_gae(inputs: TemporalInputs) -> TemporalResult:
+    """Estimate turn GAE, applying token KL only to actor advantages."""
+    if inputs.turn_ids is None:
+        raise ValueError("turn_gae requires rollout data to include 'turn_ids'")
+    rewards = inputs.rewards
+    if inputs.process_rewards is not None:
+        rewards = rewards + inputs.process_rewards
+    advantages, returns = _compute_turn_level_gae(
+        rewards=rewards,
+        values=inputs.values,
+        loss_mask=inputs.loss_mask,
+        turn_ids=inputs.turn_ids,
+        seq_no_eos_mask=inputs.seq_no_eos_mask,
+        bootstrap_values=inputs.bootstrap_values,
+        discount=inputs.discount,
+        gae_lambda=compute_gae_lambda(
+            inputs.gae_lambda,
+            inputs.loss_mask,
+            inputs.turn_ids,
+            timestep_unit="turn",
+            kwargs=inputs.gae_lambda_kwargs,
+        ),
+    )
+    if inputs.kl_rewards is not None:
+        advantages = advantages + inputs.kl_rewards
+        rewards = rewards + inputs.kl_rewards
+    return TemporalResult(advantages=advantages, returns=returns, total_rewards=rewards)
+
+
+def _shape_advantages_with_gvpo(
+    advantages: torch.Tensor,
+    token_advantages: torch.Tensor,
+    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    negative_scale: float,
+    zero_penalty: float,
+    zero_eps: float,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Shape outcome advantages where a negative process signal marks failure."""
+    for name, value in (
+        ("negative_scale", negative_scale),
+        ("zero_penalty", zero_penalty),
+        ("zero_eps", zero_eps),
+    ):
+        if not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"GVPO {name} must be finite and non-negative, got {value}"
+            )
+
+    failed_mask = (token_advantages < 0) & loss_mask.bool()
+    negative_mask = failed_mask & (advantages < -zero_eps)
+    zero_mask = failed_mask & (advantages.abs() <= zero_eps)
+    positive_mask = failed_mask & (advantages > zero_eps)
+
+    shaped = torch.where(
+        negative_mask,
+        advantages * (1.0 + negative_scale),
+        advantages,
+    )
+    shaped = torch.where(zero_mask, torch.full_like(shaped, -zero_penalty), shaped)
+    return shaped.masked_fill(positive_mask, 0.0)
+
+
+def _shape_advantages_with_process_weighting(
+    advantages: torch.Tensor,
+    process_rewards: torch.Tensor,
+    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Combine outcome advantages with process rewards in ``[0, 1]``."""
+    active_mask = loss_mask.bool()
+    rewards_in_range = (process_rewards >= 0) & (process_rewards <= 1)
+    torch._assert_async(
+        torch.all(rewards_in_range | ~active_mask),
+        "Process-weighted advantage shaping requires process rewards in [0, 1]",
+    )
+
+    shaped = torch.where(
+        advantages >= 0,
+        advantages * process_rewards,
+        torch.where(process_rewards > 0, process_rewards, advantages),
+    )
+    return torch.where(active_mask, shaped, advantages)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ProcessAdvantageInputs:
+    """Normalized advantages and next-token-aligned direct process rewards."""
+
+    advantages: torch.Tensor
+    token_local_rewards: torch.Tensor | None
+    loss_mask: torch.Tensor
+    token_rewards_as_adv: bool = True
+    mask_no_eos_with_zero: bool = False
+
+
+def additive(inputs: ProcessAdvantageInputs) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if inputs.token_local_rewards is None:
+        return inputs.advantages
+    return inputs.advantages + inputs.token_local_rewards
+
+
+def gvpo(
+    inputs: ProcessAdvantageInputs,
+    *,
+    negative_scale: float = 0.2,
+    zero_penalty: float = 0.4,
+    zero_eps: float = 1e-6,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if not inputs.token_rewards_as_adv:
+        raise ValueError("'gvpo' advantage shaping requires token_rewards_as_adv=True")
+    for name, value in (
+        ("negative_scale", negative_scale),
+        ("zero_penalty", zero_penalty),
+        ("zero_eps", zero_eps),
+    ):
+        if not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"GVPO {name} must be finite and non-negative, got {value}"
+            )
+    if inputs.token_local_rewards is None:
+        return inputs.advantages
+    return _shape_advantages_with_gvpo(
+        inputs.advantages,
+        inputs.token_local_rewards,
+        inputs.loss_mask,
+        negative_scale=negative_scale,
+        zero_penalty=zero_penalty,
+        zero_eps=zero_eps,
+    )
+
+
+def process_weighted(inputs: ProcessAdvantageInputs) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if not inputs.token_rewards_as_adv:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "'process_weighted' advantage shaping requires token_rewards_as_adv=True"
+        )
+    if inputs.mask_no_eos_with_zero:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "'process_weighted' advantage shaping is incompatible with mask_no_eos_with_zero=True"
+        )
+    if inputs.token_local_rewards is None:
+        return inputs.advantages
+    return _shape_advantages_with_process_weighting(
+        inputs.advantages, inputs.token_local_rewards, inputs.loss_mask
+    )

+def _bind_loss_function(
+    function: Callable[..., torch.Tensor],
+    kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+    config: PPOActorConfig,
+) -> partial[torch.Tensor]:
+    """Bind explicit built-in defaults, then validate the single plugin ABI."""
+    runtime_names = {"outputs", "batch", "mask"}
+    if runtime_names & kwargs.keys():
+        raise ValueError("Loss kwargs cannot override outputs, batch, or mask")
+    defaults = {}
+    if function in {policy_loss}:
+        defaults = {
+            name: getattr(config, name)
+            for name in (
+                "eps_clip",
+                "eps_clip_higher",
+                "c_clip",
+                "rejection_sampling",
+                "importance_sampling_level",
+                "prox_logp_method",
+                "use_sapo_loss",
+                "sapo_tau_pos",
+                "sapo_tau_neg",
+                "use_cispo_loss",
+                "use_decoupled_loss",
+            )
+        }
+    elif function is mopd_loss:
+        defaults = {
+            # Legacy SAPO does not narrow its teacher support via rejection.
+            # Explicit per-term kwargs may still opt into independent filtering.
+            "rejection_sampling": None
+            if config.use_sapo_loss
+            else config.rejection_sampling,
+            "prox_logp_method": config.prox_logp_method,
+        }
+    options = defaults | kwargs
+    if function in {policy_loss, mopd_loss}:
+        # These options also control actor-side preprocessing/forward passes.
+        # A per-term override cannot silently change the meaning of batch data.
+        for name in ("prox_logp_method", "use_decoupled_loss"):
+            if name in options and options[name] != getattr(config, name):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Loss {name} must match actor.{name}; it controls batch preparation"
+                )
+        if (
+            ProxLogpMethod(options["prox_logp_method"])
+            == ProxLogpMethod.REUSE_TRAIN_LOGP
+            and config.ppo_n_minibatches != 1
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("reuse_train_logp requires actor.ppo_n_minibatches=1")
+        rejection = options.get("rejection_sampling")
+        if isinstance(rejection, Mapping):
+            fields = dict(rejection)
+            # RPC DictConfig can contain the constructor's normalized clamp
+            # default (lower=0). Rehydrate via its equivalent input lower=None.
+            if fields.get("action") == "clamp" and fields.get("lower") == 0:
+                fields["lower"] = None
+            options["rejection_sampling"] = RejectionSamplingConfig(**fields)
+        elif rejection is not None and not isinstance(
+            rejection, RejectionSamplingConfig
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Loss rejection_sampling must be a config mapping or None")
+    if function in {policy_loss}:
+        if "advantages" in kwargs:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Loss advantages are runtime targets; configure advantages_key instead"
+            )
+        _validate_policy_options(options)
+    validation_function = function
+    try:
+        parameters = signature(function).parameters
+        if any(
+            name not in parameters or parameters[name].kind != Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
+            for name in runtime_names
+        ):

+                "outputs, batch, mask must be explicit keyword-only parameters"
+            )

+    """Validate the effective per-term surrogate, not only actor defaults."""
+    for name in ("use_sapo_loss", "use_cispo_loss", "use_decoupled_loss"):
+        if not isinstance(options[name], bool):
+            raise ValueError(f"Loss {name} must be boolean")
+    if options["importance_sampling_level"] not in {"token", "sequence"}:
+        raise ValueError("Loss importance_sampling_level must be token or sequence")
+    if options["use_sapo_loss"] and options["use_cispo_loss"]:
+        raise ValueError("CISPO and SAPO are mutually exclusive surrogates")
+    for name in ("eps_clip", "eps_clip_higher", "c_clip"):
+        value = options[name]
+        if value is None and name != "eps_clip":
+            continue
+        if (
+            isinstance(value, bool)
+            or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
+            or not math.isfinite(value)
+            or value < 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Loss {name} must be finite and nonnegative")
+    if options["c_clip"] is not None and options["c_clip"] <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("Loss c_clip must be greater than one")
+    if "advantages_key" in options and (
+        not isinstance(options["advantages_key"], str) or not options["advantages_key"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Loss advantages_key must be a nonempty string")
+    if options["use_sapo_loss"]:
+        if options["use_decoupled_loss"]:
+            raise ValueError("SAPO is not compatible with use_decoupled_loss=True")
+        for name in ("sapo_tau_pos", "sapo_tau_neg"):
+            value = options[name]
+            if (

+                or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
+                or not math.isfinite(value)

+        if (
+            isinstance(upper, bool)
+            or not isinstance(upper, (int, float))
+            or not math.isfinite(upper)
+            or upper <= 0
+        ):

+        if options["importance_sampling_level"] != "token":
+            raise ValueError("CISPO only supports importance_sampling_level='token'")

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ResolvedLoss:
+    name: str
+    function: Callable[..., torch.Tensor]
+    coefficient: float
+    reduction: str
+    mask_key: str
+
+    def key(self, suffix: str) -> str:
+        return f"_actor_loss_{self.name}_{suffix}"
+
+    def view(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        view = dict(data)
+        view["loss_mask"] = data[self.key("support")]
+        for key in (PG_TOKEN_WEIGHTS, PG_TURN_COUNTS):
+            if self.key(key) in data:
+                view[key] = data[self.key(key)]

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ActorLossStep:

+        return named_loss_normalizer(names=[term.name for term in self.terms])(

+        return {
+            term.name: step.loss_weight(term.view(data))
+            for term, step in zip(self.terms, self.reductions, strict=True)
+        }
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        logprobs: torch.Tensor,
+        entropy: torch.Tensor,
+        input_data: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        current_version: int | None = None,
+        **vocab_stats: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        outputs = MappingProxyType(
+            {
+                "logprobs": logprobs,
+                "entropy": entropy,
+                **{k: v for k, v in vocab_stats.items() if v is not None},
+            }
+        )
+        batch = MappingProxyType(
+            {
+                **{
+                    k: v
+                    for k, v in input_data.items()
+                    if not k.startswith("_actor_loss_")
+                },
+                "current_version": current_version,
+            }
+        )
+        result = {}
+        for term, step in zip(self.terms, self.reductions, strict=True):
+            view = term.view(input_data)
+            mask = view["loss_mask"]
+            with stats_tracker.scope(term.name):
+                values = term.function(outputs=outputs, batch=batch, mask=mask)
+            if (
+                not isinstance(values, torch.Tensor)
+                or values.shape != mask.shape
+                or values.device != mask.device
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Token losses must match their support shape and device"
+                )
+            if (
+                torch.is_grad_enabled()
+                and logprobs.requires_grad
+                and not values.requires_grad
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Token losses must retain a differentiable connection to model outputs"
+                )
+            if not values.is_floating_point():
+                raise ValueError("Token losses must be floating point")
+            values = torch.where(mask, values, 0.0)
+            torch._assert_async(
+                torch.isfinite(values).all(),
+                "Token losses must be finite on their support",
+            )
+            reduction = step.bind(view)
+            mass = reduction.normalizer()
+            mean = reduction.aggregate(values, mask)
+            result[term.name] = mean * mass * term.coefficient
+            with stats_tracker.scope(term.name):
+                stats_tracker.weighted_mean(
+                    "loss/avg", mean.detach() * term.coefficient, mass
+                )

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PreparedActorLoss:
+    terms: tuple[ResolvedLoss, ...]
+    batches: tuple[PreparedLossBatch, ...]
+
+    def for_steps(
+        self, microbatches: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], *, dp_group=None, device=None
+    ) -> list[ActorLossStep]:
+        steps = [
+            batch.for_steps(microbatches, dp_group=dp_group, device=device)
+            for batch in self.batches
+        ]
+        return [
+            ActorLossStep(self.terms, tuple(column[i] for column in steps))
+            for i in range(len(microbatches))
+        ]

+                function = import_from_string(spec.implementation)
+            if not callable(function):

+            mask = data.get(term.mask_key)

+            view = {**data, "loss_mask": support}
+            prepared.append(

+                )
+            )

+                if key in view:
+                    data[term.key(key)] = view[key]

+def policy_loss(
+    *,
+    outputs: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    batch: Mapping[str, Any],
+    mask: torch.Tensor,
+    eps_clip: float = 0.2,
+    eps_clip_higher: float | None = None,
+    c_clip: float | None = None,
+    rejection_sampling: RejectionSamplingConfig | None = None,
+    importance_sampling_level: str = "token",
+    prox_logp_method: str = PROX_LOGP_METHOD_RECOMPUTE,
+    use_sapo_loss: bool = False,
+    sapo_tau_pos: float = 1.0,
+    sapo_tau_neg: float = 1.05,
+    use_cispo_loss: bool = False,
+    use_decoupled_loss: bool = False,
+    advantages_key: str = "advantages",
+    advantages: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute the PPO/SAPO/CISPO surrogate without reduction or teacher terms."""
+    # Teacher objectives are peers in the named interface, never implicit here.
+    data = {
+        key: value
+        for key, value in batch.items()
+        if key
+        not in {
+            "teacher_logp",
+            "mopd_teacher_logp_sum",
+        }
+    }
+    data["loss_mask"] = mask
+    for key in ("logprobs", "prox_logp"):
+        if data.get(key) is not None:
+            data[key] = torch.where(mask, data[key].detach(), 0.0)
+    if advantages is None:
+        advantages = data[advantages_key]
+    data["advantages"] = torch.where(mask, advantages.detach(), 0.0)
+    loss, stat, effective_mask, _ = compute_policy_surrogate(
+        torch.where(mask, outputs["logprobs"], 0.0),
+        data,
+        mask,
+        _Unreduced(),
+        eps_clip=eps_clip,
+        eps_clip_higher=eps_clip_higher,
+        c_clip=c_clip,
+        rejection_sampling=rejection_sampling,
+        importance_sampling_level=importance_sampling_level,
+        current_version=batch.get("current_version"),
+        prox_logp_method=prox_logp_method,
+        use_sapo_loss=use_sapo_loss,
+        sapo_tau_pos=sapo_tau_pos,
+        sapo_tau_neg=sapo_tau_neg,
+        use_cispo_loss=use_cispo_loss,
+        use_decoupled_loss=use_decoupled_loss,
+    )
+    stats_tracker.denominator(n_valid_tokens=effective_mask.bool())
+    stats_tracker.stat(
+        importance_weight=stat["importance_weight"].float(),
+        approx_kl=stat["approx_kl"].float(),
+        clip_ratio=stat["clip_mask"].float(),
+        dual_clip_ratio=stat["dual_clip_mask"].float(),
+        denominator="n_valid_tokens",
+    )
+    if "behave_mask" in stat:
+        stats_tracker.denominator(n_retained_tokens=stat["behave_mask"])
+        stats_tracker.stat(
+            behave_imp_weight=stat["behave_imp_weight"].float(),
+            denominator="n_retained_tokens",
+        )
+        stats_tracker.scalar(rs_filtered_fraction=stat["filtered_fraction"])
+    return loss
+
+
+class _Unreduced:
+    def normalizer(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        raise RuntimeError("Token loss computation does not request a normalizer")
+
+    def aggregate(
+        self, loss: torch.Tensor, numerator_mask: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return torch.where(numerator_mask.bool(), loss, 0.0)
+
+
+def entropy_loss(
+    *,
+    outputs: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    batch: Mapping[str, Any],
+    mask: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Negative entropy: a positive coefficient encourages exploration."""
+    if (
+        torch.is_grad_enabled()
+        and outputs["logprobs"].requires_grad
+        and not outputs["entropy"].requires_grad
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Entropy loss requires differentiable entropy; enable megatron.entropy_requires_grad for Megatron"
+        )
+    return -torch.where(mask, outputs["entropy"], 0.0)
+
+
+def mopd_loss(
+    *,
+    outputs: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    batch: Mapping[str, Any],
+    mask: torch.Tensor,
+    importance_ratio_cap: float = 5.0,
+    rejection_sampling: RejectionSamplingConfig | None = None,
+    prox_logp_method: str = PROX_LOGP_METHOD_RECOMPUTE,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Multi-teacher distillation with independent reduction and coefficient."""
+    behavior_logp = batch.get("mopd_behavior_logprobs")
+    if behavior_logp is None:
+        raise ValueError("Named MOPD requires immutable mopd_behavior_logprobs")
+    normalization_mask = mask
+    if rejection_sampling is not None:
+        prox = batch.get("prox_logp")
+        if ProxLogpMethod(prox_logp_method) == ProxLogpMethod.REUSE_TRAIN_LOGP:
+            prox = outputs["logprobs"].detach()
+        prox = _resolve_proximal_logp(
+            prox_logp_gt=prox,
+            prox_logp_method=prox_logp_method,
+            old_logp=batch["logprobs"],
+            logprobs=outputs["logprobs"].detach(),
+            versions=batch.get("versions"),
+            current_version=batch.get("current_version"),
+        )
+        mask = apply_rejection_sampling(
+            proximal_logprobs=prox,
+            old_logprobs=batch["logprobs"],
+            loss_mask=mask,
+            cu_seqlens=batch.get("cu_seqlens"),
+            config=rejection_sampling,
+        ).loss_mask
+    loss, _ = mopd_loss_fn(
+        logprobs=outputs["logprobs"],
+        old_logprobs=behavior_logp,
+        teacher_logp_sum=batch["mopd_teacher_logp_sum"],
+        teacher_weight_sum=batch["mopd_teacher_weight_sum"],
+        loss_mask=mask,
+        normalization_mask=normalization_mask,
+        importance_ratio_cap=importance_ratio_cap,
+        reduction="none",
+    )
+    return loss
+
+
+LOSS_FUNCTIONS = {
+    "policy": policy_loss,
+    "entropy": entropy_loss,
+    "mopd": mopd_loss,
+}

+# Composable actor losses
+
+`actor.losses` defines named token objectives with independent support, reduction, and
+coefficients. An empty mapping preserves the existing PPO/PRM/MOPD objective. A nonempty
+mapping replaces that implicit objective: include a policy term when policy optimization
+is desired.
+
+```yaml
+actor:
+  loss_aggregation: token_mean
+  losses:
+    policy:
+      implementation: policy
+      reduction: prompt_mean
+    exploration:
+      implementation: entropy
+      coefficient: 0.01
+  megatron:
+    entropy_requires_grad: true
+```
+
+The built-ins are `policy` (PPO, SAPO, or CISPO using the actor defaults), `entropy`
+(negative entropy), and `mopd` (multi-teacher distillation). Entropy must be
+differentiable; for Megatron enable `entropy_requires_grad` and use a compatible LM-head
+configuration. Loss plugins are resolved once on each actor worker.
+
+## Configuration and precedence
+
+Each term accepts `implementation`, `enabled`, `coefficient`, `reduction`, `mask_key`,
+and `kwargs`. Coefficients must be finite and nonnegative. Disabled or zero-coefficient
+terms are not imported or evaluated; at least one term must be active. `kwargs` must be
+JSON-serializable and cannot override runtime arguments.
+
+An omitted `reduction` inherits `actor.loss_aggregation`. This is the single default
+entry point; migrate source configurations using `default_loss_reduction` to
+`loss_aggregation`. Explicit built-in kwargs override actor defaults, except settings
+that control actor preprocessing (`prox_logp_method` and `use_decoupled_loss`), which
+must agree with the actor.
+
+`mask_key` defaults to `loss_mask`. It selects a binary token-shaped batch tensor,
+intersected with `loss_mask` before optimizer splitting. The resulting support fixes
+normalization; subsequent rejection filtering changes only the numerator. Zero reward
+does not imply absent support. Custom masks must already use prediction (next-token
+label) positions, matching the post-advantage `loss_mask`; they are not shifted
+automatically. Raw rollout `turn_ids` are shifted separately.
+
+## Reductions
+
+| Reduction     | Objective                                                                               |
+| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `token_mean`  | Mean over supported tokens.                                                             |
+| `seq_mean`    | Mean of supported-token means over active responses.                                    |
+| `constant`    | Token sum divided by active responses times `actor.loss_aggregation_divisor`.           |
+| `turn_mean`   | Mean of supported-token means over active turns.                                        |
+| `prompt_mean` | Equal active-prompt weighting, with equal supported-token weighting within each prompt. |
+
+Each loss uses its own support and denominator. A globally empty named term contributes
+a differentiable zero. `turn_mean` requires raw token-aligned `turn_ids`; the actor
+shifts them to prediction positions. Turn weights and counts are prepared before packing
+or microbatch splitting. IDs may repeat across responses but must be nonnegative and
+nondecreasing on supported tokens within a response, and smaller than its padded
+sequence length.
+
+`prompt_mean` preserves the existing response-level optimizer schedule. A prompt may
+span optimizer steps. For `K` realized steps and `G` globally active prompt groups for a
+term, each step uses the full-update coefficients scaled by `K/G`. At fixed parameters,
+averaging step contributions recovers the full-update objective. This does not imply
+that sequential parameter updates equal one large optimizer update. Fully masked groups
+do not contribute to `G`.
+
+The engine receives one summed numerator and one normalizer per name. The coefficient
+multiplies the numerator exactly once. All ranks and microbatches retain the same name
+schema, including empty terms and transport-only ranks.
+
+## Custom token losses
+
+Use an importable dotted callable with explicit keyword-only runtime arguments:
+
+```python
+import torch
+
+
+def custom_loss(*, outputs, batch, mask, scale=1.0):
+    return torch.where(mask, -scale * outputs["entropy"], 0.0)
+```
+
+`outputs` includes differentiable `logprobs`, `entropy`, and available vocabulary
+statistics. `batch` includes prepared advantages and the current policy version. Both
+mappings are read-only; do not mutate their tensors. Return a differentiable
+floating-point tensor with the same shape and device as `mask`. Values on support must
+be finite. Do not reduce the result or renormalize after numerator filtering. The
+callback may receive padded or packed tensors and must handle both layouts.
+
+## Compatibility and limits
+
+- The unnamed objective and its diagnostics retain their existing behavior.
+- Named terms report their own weighted loss means. Named policy terms also report
+  clipping, importance-weight, KL, and rejection statistics; the complete legacy
+  proximal-approximation diagnostic set is not reproduced for each named term.
+- Named MOPD uses immutable `mopd_behavior_logprobs`, not recomputed PPO logprobs. Its
+  coefficient and `importance_ratio_cap` kwarg determine the actual named objective.
+  `mopd.loss` still controls whether teacher targets and RL advantages are prepared; it
+  does not add a second implicit loss or override named coefficients. Enable teacher
+  targets when using a named MOPD term. A policy term cannot be combined with
+  pure-distillation preprocessing.
+- Legacy single-teacher `teacher_logp` and forward-dependent M2PO selection are
+  unsupported with explicit named losses; their unnamed paths remain available.
+- Tree-packed training supports only `token_mean` terms.
+- Separate process-reward loss routing, efficiency presets, and turn-reward ingestion
+  are outside this interface. Existing PRM advantage shaping remains available through
+  the advantage pipeline.

+# Custom advantage computation
+
+`actor.advantage` selects the whole advantage computation or individual stages. With the
+default configuration, existing GAE, reward normalization, and PRM settings retain their
+behavior. The configuration contains import paths and JSON-serializable keyword
+arguments; each actor worker resolves its functions at initialization.
+
+```yaml
+actor:
+  advantage:
+    compute:
+      implementation: default
+      kwargs: {}
+    outcome_reward_shaping: null
+    estimator: null
+    process_adv_shaping: null
+```
+
+The default pipeline applies length penalties, outcome shaping, reward scaling and
+normalization, temporal estimation, advantage normalization, then process advantage
+shaping. Loss aggregation and optimizer minibatch scheduling are unchanged.
+
+| Stage                    | Built-in implementations               | Default                                    |
+| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
+| `outcome_reward_shaping` | `identity`                             | Unmodified outcome reward                  |
+| `estimator`              | `token_gae`, `turn_gae`                | Follows `actor.gae_timestep_unit`          |
+| `process_adv_shaping`    | `additive`, `gvpo`, `process_weighted` | Existing PRM selection, otherwise additive |
+
+Every stage also accepts an importable dotted Python function path and `kwargs`. `auto`
+selects the stage default. Process `auto` does not accept kwargs. Explicit process
+selection wins over call-local PRM selection; explicit GVPO kwargs override legacy GVPO
+values, while unspecified values inherit them. Existing PRM settings remain supported.
+
+```yaml
+actor:
+  token_rewards_as_adv: true
+  advantage:
+    estimator:
+      implementation: turn_gae
+      kwargs: {}
+    process_adv_shaping:
+      implementation: gvpo
+      kwargs:
+        negative_scale: 0.2
+        zero_penalty: 0.4
+```
+
+Turn GAE requires rollout `turn_ids`. Its token KL penalties affect actor advantages but
+not critic returns. Token GAE includes KL in the recurrence. A custom GAE lambda
+receives lengths in the selected estimator's timestep unit, including when the estimator
+overrides `gae_timestep_unit`. Existing `GAELambdaContext` functions remain supported;
+`GAELambdaInputs` is an alias for the same type.
+
+## Stage functions
+
+Outcome functions accept `OutcomeRewardInputs` from `areal.trainer.ppo.advantage`. Its
+`data` contains rollout tensors after the length penalty, `config` is the actor
+configuration, and `meta` contains trajectory and logical rollout grouping. Return
+`OutcomeResult(rewards=...)` with one floating-point reward per tensor row:
+
+```python
+from areal.trainer.ppo.advantage import OutcomeResult, OutcomeRewardInputs
+
+
+def scale_outcome(inputs: OutcomeRewardInputs, *, factor: float) -> OutcomeResult:
+    return OutcomeResult(rewards=inputs.data["rewards"] * factor)
+```
+
+Use `implementation: my_package.my_module.scale_outcome` and `kwargs: {factor: 0.5}`.
+The module must be available on every actor worker. Functions must preserve tensor row
+order, grouping, and device. Do not modify the input mapping or its tensors in place.
+
+When reward normalization uses explicit logical rollout references, custom shaping must
+also return `OutcomeResult.normalization_rewards`: one shaped reference per logical
+rollout, before bias, scaling, and clipping. Read the raw references and row mapping
+from `meta.rollout_groups`. Without explicit references, equal rows within a logical
+rollout allow reference inference; differing rows require explicit shaped references.
+`meta.traj_group_sizes` counts tensor rows per prompt, while `meta.logical_group_sizes`
+counts logical rollouts per prompt. Shaped references require complete metadata produced
+by `concat_batch`; they do not change membership or row counts. Distributed plugins
+should use framework metadata rather than constructing partial metadata themselves.
+
+Temporal functions accept `TemporalInputs` from `areal.trainer.ppo.advantage_algorithms`
+and return `TemporalResult(advantages, returns, total_rewards)`. Inputs use next-token
+prediction alignment. Outcome, KL, and folded process rewards are separate channels. The
+explicit `bootstrap_values` come from each trajectory's actual final valid token.
+Callable lambda functions can be resolved with `compute_gae_lambda` in
+`areal.trainer.ppo.gae`, passing the estimator's timestep unit. `total_rewards` is the
+token-aligned monitoring channel.
+
+Process functions accept `ProcessAdvantageInputs` and return a tensor of advantages.
+They receive normalized advantages, aligned direct token rewards (possibly `None`), and
+the loss mask. They do not change critic returns. Built-in GVPO and process-weighted
+shaping require `token_rewards_as_adv=True`; process-weighted shaping also requires
+`mask_no_eos_with_zero=False`.
+
+## Replacing the full computation
+
+Set `compute.implementation` to a dotted function path accepting `AdvantageInputs` and
+returning `AdvantageResult`. A full override cannot be combined with stage settings. The
+default compute does not accept kwargs; configure its stages instead.
+
+`AdvantageResult` supplies advantages, returns, loss mask, aligned log probabilities,
+outcome rewards, total rewards, and KL rewards. Outputs must be finite floating-point
+tensors on the expected device and with the expected shape; masks must be binary. The
+identity outcome stage also preserves legacy integer task rewards. The optional `extras`
+mapping may contain only `input_token_loss_mask`, `is_truncated`,
+`mopd_behavior_logprobs`, `prox_logp`, and `ref_logp`. It cannot replace input IDs,
+values, original rewards, or other rollout fields. A full override owns alignment and
+must supply the derived metadata needed by its training mode, including immutable
+behavior log probabilities when combining with MOPD.

+# 可组合的 actor loss
+
+`actor.losses` 配置具有独立 support、归一化方式和系数的命名 token 目标。 空映射保留现有 PPO/PRM/MOPD
+目标；非空映射替换隐式目标，需要策略优化时必须显式包含 policy 项。
+
+```yaml
+actor:
+  loss_aggregation: token_mean
+  losses:
+    policy:
+      implementation: policy
+      reduction: prompt_mean
+    exploration:
+      implementation: entropy
+      coefficient: 0.01
+  megatron:
+    entropy_requires_grad: true
+```
+
+内置实现包括 `policy`（沿用 actor 的 PPO、SAPO 或 CISPO 设置）、`entropy`（负熵）和 `mopd`（多教师蒸馏）。entropy
+必须可求梯度；Megatron 需要启用 `entropy_requires_grad` 并使用兼容的 LM-head 配置。插件在每个 actor worker 上解析一次。
+
+## 配置与优先级
+
+每项支持 `implementation`、`enabled`、`coefficient`、`reduction`、`mask_key` 和
+`kwargs`。系数必须有限且非负。禁用或零系数项不导入、不执行；至少需要一个有效项。 kwargs 必须可 JSON 序列化，不得覆盖运行时参数。
+
+未指定 `reduction` 时继承 `actor.loss_aggregation`，这是唯一的默认入口。 源分支的 `default_loss_reduction`
+应迁移为 `loss_aggregation`。 显式内置 kwargs 覆盖 actor 默认值，但影响预处理的 `prox_logp_method` 与
+`use_decoupled_loss` 必须与 actor 一致。
+
+`mask_key` 默认是 `loss_mask`，指定与其同形状的二值 token mask。两者的交集在 optimizer 拆分前确定 support
+和归一化分母；后续 rejection filtering 仅改变分子。零奖励不代表缺少 support。自定义 mask 必须已经对齐预测位置（next-token
+label）， 与 advantage 计算后的 `loss_mask` 一致，不会自动移位；原始 rollout `turn_ids` 会单独移位。
+
+## 归一化方式
+
+| reduction     | 目标                                                                       |
+| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `token_mean`  | 有效 token 的平均值。                                                      |
+| `seq_mean`    | 先计算每条有效 response 的 token 均值，再对 response 求均值。              |
+| `constant`    | token 总和除以有效 response 数与 `actor.loss_aggregation_divisor` 的乘积。 |
+| `turn_mean`   | 先计算每个有效 turn 的 token 均值，再对 turn 求均值。                      |
+| `prompt_mean` | 有效 prompt 等权，各 prompt 内有效 token 等权。                            |
+
+每项使用自己的 support 与分母。全局无有效 token 的命名项贡献可微分的零。 `turn_mean` 需要原始 token 对齐的 `turn_ids`，actor
+将它移位到预测位置。 turn 权重和数量在 packing 或 microbatch 拆分前准备。 不同 response 可以复用 ID，但一条 response 的有效
+token ID 必须非负、单调不减且小于 padded 序列长度。
+
+`prompt_mean` 保留 main 按 response 划分 optimizer step 的调度，同一 prompt 可以跨 step。 设实际 step 数为
+K，该项在整个 update 的全局有效 prompt 数为 G，每步使用完整 update 的 权重并乘以
+K/G。固定参数时，各步贡献的平均值恢复完整目标；这不意味着多次参数更新与一次大步更新相同。 全空 group 不计入 G。
+
+引擎接收每个名称独立的分子和 normalizer。系数仅乘入分子一次。 所有 rank、microbatch、空项和 transport-only rank
+均保留同一名称集合。
+
+## 自定义 token loss
+
+实现可导入的 dotted callable，并显式声明 keyword-only 运行时参数：
+
+```python
+import torch
+
+
+def custom_loss(*, outputs, batch, mask, scale=1.0):
+    return torch.where(mask, -scale * outputs["entropy"], 0.0)
+```
+
+outputs 包含 `logprobs`、`entropy` 和可用的 vocabulary 统计，batch 包含准备好的 advantage 和当前策略版本。两个
+mapping 均只读，也不要原地修改其中的 tensor。 返回与 mask 同形状、同设备、可微分的浮点 tensor，有效位置必须有限。
+不要自行归约，也不要在过滤分子后重新计算分母。回调必须兼容 padded 和 packed 布局。
+
+## 兼容性与限制
+
+- 未启用命名 loss 时，原目标与诊断行为保持不变。
+- 每个命名项记录独立的加权 loss 均值；policy 还记录 clipping、importance weight、KL 和 rejection
+  指标，但不会为每个项完整复制原有 proximal approximation 诊断集合。
+- 命名 MOPD 使用不可变的 `mopd_behavior_logprobs`，不使用重算后的 PPO logprobs。 命名项的 coefficient 和
+  `importance_ratio_cap` kwarg 决定实际目标。 `mopd.loss` 仍决定是否准备教师目标和 RL advantage，但不额外叠加隐式
+  loss，也不覆盖命名系数。 使用命名 MOPD 必须启用教师目标；policy 项不能配合纯蒸馏预处理。
+- 显式命名 loss 不支持旧式 `teacher_logp` 和依赖 forward 的 M2PO 选择；原有未命名路径继续支持。
+- tree-packed 训练仅支持 `token_mean`。
+- 独立 process reward loss 路由、efficiency presets 和 turn reward 数据接入不属于本接口。 现有 PRM
+  advantage shaping 继续通过 advantage pipeline 使用。

+# 自定义优势计算
+
+`actor.advantage` 可以选择完整优势计算函数，也可以单独替换计算阶段。默认配置保留现有 GAE、奖励归一化和 PRM 行为。配置只保存导入路径和可 JSON
+序列化的参数，各 actor worker 在初始化时解析函数。
+
+```yaml
+actor:
+  advantage:
+    compute:
+      implementation: default
+      kwargs: {}
+    outcome_reward_shaping: null
+    estimator: null
+    process_adv_shaping: null
+```
+
+默认流程依次执行长度惩罚、outcome shaping、奖励缩放与归一化、时序估计、优势归一化、process advantage shaping。Loss
+aggregation 和 optimizer minibatch 调度保持不变。
+
+| 阶段                     | 内置实现                               | 默认行为                         |
+| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
+| `outcome_reward_shaping` | `identity`                             | 保留 outcome reward              |
+| `estimator`              | `token_gae`、`turn_gae`                | 跟随 `actor.gae_timestep_unit`   |
+| `process_adv_shaping`    | `additive`、`gvpo`、`process_weighted` | 使用现有 PRM 选择，否则 additive |
+
+每个阶段也支持可导入的 Python 函数路径和 `kwargs`。`auto` 使用阶段默认实现；process 的 `auto` 不接受 kwargs。显式 process
+选择优先于调用时传入的 PRM 选择；显式 GVPO 参数覆盖旧参数，未指定的参数沿用旧值。现有 PRM 配置仍受支持。
+
+```yaml
+actor:
+  token_rewards_as_adv: true
+  advantage:
+    estimator:
+      implementation: turn_gae
+      kwargs: {}
+    process_adv_shaping:
+      implementation: gvpo
+      kwargs:
+        negative_scale: 0.2
+        zero_penalty: 0.4
+```
+
+Turn GAE 要求 rollout 提供 `turn_ids`。其 token KL 惩罚只影响 actor advantages，不进入 critic
+returns；token GAE 则将 KL 纳入递推。自定义 GAE lambda 接收实际 estimator 对应的时间单位长度，即使 estimator 覆盖了
+`gae_timestep_unit`。原有 `GAELambdaContext` 函数仍可用，`GAELambdaInputs` 是同一类型的别名。
+
+## 阶段函数
+
+Outcome 函数接收 `areal.trainer.ppo.advantage.OutcomeRewardInputs`。其中 `data` 是长度惩罚后的 rollout
+数据，`config` 为 actor 配置，`meta` 包含轨迹与 logical rollout 分组信息。返回
+`OutcomeResult(rewards=...)`，每个 tensor row 对应一个浮点奖励：
+
+```python
+from areal.trainer.ppo.advantage import OutcomeResult, OutcomeRewardInputs
+
+
+def scale_outcome(inputs: OutcomeRewardInputs, *, factor: float) -> OutcomeResult:
+    return OutcomeResult(rewards=inputs.data["rewards"] * factor)
+```
+
+配置 `implementation: my_package.my_module.scale_outcome` 和
+`kwargs: {factor: 0.5}`。该模块需要在所有 actor worker 上可导入。函数必须保持行顺序、分组和设备，不应原地修改输入 mapping 或
+tensor。
+
+奖励归一化使用显式 logical rollout 参考奖励时，自定义 shaping 还必须返回
+`OutcomeResult.normalization_rewards`：每个 logical rollout 一个变换后的参考值，尚未经过 bias、scaling 和
+clipping。原始参考值与行映射在 `meta.rollout_groups` 中。没有显式参考值时，同一 logical rollout
+内各行奖励相同即可推导参考值；各行不同则需要提供显式 shaped references。`meta.traj_group_sizes` 统计每个 prompt 的
+tensor row 数，`meta.logical_group_sizes` 统计 logical rollout 数。Shaped references 要求提供
+`concat_batch` 生成的完整 metadata，不能改变行数或分组成员。分布式插件应使用框架提供的 metadata，不应自行构造不完整的分组信息。
+
+时序函数接收 `areal.trainer.ppo.advantage_algorithms.TemporalInputs`，返回
+`TemporalResult(advantages, returns, total_rewards)`。输入已按 next-token prediction
+对齐，outcome、KL 和折叠后的 process rewards 分开传递。显式 `bootstrap_values` 来自每条轨迹实际最后一个有效 token。自定义
+estimator 可调用 `areal.trainer.ppo.gae.compute_gae_lambda`，传入自身的时间单位以解析 callable
+lambda。`total_rewards` 是按 token 对齐的监控奖励。
+
+Process 函数接收 `ProcessAdvantageInputs`，返回 advantage tensor。输入包含归一化后的 advantages、对齐后的直接
+token rewards（可能为 `None`）和 loss mask，不修改 critic returns。内置 GVPO 与 process-weighted 要求
+`token_rewards_as_adv=True`；process-weighted 还要求 `mask_no_eos_with_zero=False`。
+
+## 替换完整计算
+
+将 `compute.implementation` 设为接收 `AdvantageInputs`、返回 `AdvantageResult`
+的函数路径。完整替换不能与阶段配置同时使用。默认 compute 不接受 kwargs，应通过阶段参数配置。
+
+`AdvantageResult` 包含 advantages、returns、loss mask、对齐后的 log probabilities、outcome
+rewards、total rewards 和 KL rewards。输出必须具有正确的形状和设备，使用有限浮点数；mask 必须为二值。Identity outcome
+阶段也保留旧工作流中整数任务奖励的类型。可选 `extras` 仅允许包含
+`input_token_loss_mask`、`is_truncated`、`mopd_behavior_logprobs`、`prox_logp` 和
+`ref_logp`，不能覆盖 input IDs、values、original rewards 等 rollout
+字段。完整替换函数负责对齐与训练模式需要的派生信息，包括与 MOPD 组合时保存不可变的 behavior log probabilities。
